snippet.title: Pvz's Brand NEW DLC Mod 2024
snippet.description:
Thank you @susstew3787 for being a huge inspiration for this mod and for revolutionizing pvz1 modding.

If you want to stay updated for the DLC mod then make sure to join our
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/rTz2QHD9aR
 
I forgot to mention @I_existokay in this video. Thank you for making the lightning reed textures! Check out @zooweeminecraft5752 channel too!

Thank you @MisterKazePresents for your amazing soundtrack!

ART DESIGNERS:
Opexe: Electric Peashooter
I_exist: Lightning Reed
Sn0w Cl0v3r: Hurrikale, Chilly Pepper
Claire: Plasma Peashooter
Milkchocolatecookie: Sea StarFruit
ZooWeeMinecraft: Fire Peashooter, Ice Queen
RealMadManMatthew: Scarecrow Zombie, Pepperpult
Raducu: Ice Block Zombie

ANIMATIONS:
ZooWeeMinecraft: Water pot, Lightning Reed, Fire Peashooter, SeaFruit, Ice Queen, Plasma Peashooter, Electric Peashooter, Fire-shroom, Flamewood and much more
Bandit: Super Chomper
Dr. Zomboss: Pickled Pepper (also helped with the organisation)
Ayban: Hurrikale

PROGRAMMER:
DrunkenCat: Pepperpult Projectile Fire Rotation
